en: Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century tenement buildings on a curved boulevard. A corner building with a towered cupola dominates the view; there are balconies, a small kiosk, young street trees, pedestrians, a cyclist, and a horse‑drawn cart. The red caption at top left reads "Danzig. Neue Pfefferstadt." and the publisher credit appears at bottom left.
